title: Checkout 5xx spike after a pool change
story: A config change lowers the ledger connection pool in payments-core to 20. About an hour after it deploys, in the middle of a customer's sale, checkout starts returning errors.

title: Webhook delivery failures after a fraud client pool change
story: A change lowers the fraud-scorer client pool to 5. Two days later webhook deliveries start failing, on a service nobody touched.

title: Card authorisations failing during an acquirer outage
story: CardNet, the outside card acquirer that payments-core relies on, has an outage. Nothing in the company's own code changed.
